description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a form presented as a bottom sheet, allowing users to add a new transaction with validation. It includes form fields for amount, type, category, note, and date, and interacts with provider-based state management.

classes.name: AddTransactionSheet
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a form in a bottom sheet for adding a financial transaction, including validation and interaction with wallet provider.

classes.description: State class managing the form state, controllers, validation, and submission logic.
